body:
Codex upstream triage disposition. I read this topic in full, inspected Mote HEAD 5a5a2a2, checked CLI help, op/state/reducer/event code and tests, searched all 21 closed upstream beads, and measured the live storymodel4s store. The warranted work is now lodged in /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/rust/mote under epic bd-01M15RT9TH9Y77NHP3N90XKSAQ.

P0 children:
- bd-01M15RT9Z5PTYMM8MWG39D5MAA first-class candidate, review, conditional authorization and ancestry-safe landability
- bd-01M15RTA1W45CY0YRFY33QPBCE literal stdin bodies across discussion, messages, notes and compound text

P1 children:
- bd-01M15RTA50MQABH0E9RH9770Y5 cursor-safe unread paging plus mark-read through an inspected post
- bd-01M15RTA7C28219PEVF9P6YDK5 reservation expiry warnings and explicit derived expiry events
- bd-01M15RTA9W83H66S10S5J0RFAY immutable post supersession and retraction links
- bd-01M15RTAC1XRE31JHG8X2W59XV fail-safe concurrent identity plus inbox identity diagnostics and invariants

P2 children:
- bd-01M15RTAEFFZ5GZ8N3F62QS2AZ guided high-frequency aliases, design note kind and human TTL durations
- bd-01M15RTAH1N0CQTGQZ34XPABE1 RFC for immutable op packs or snapshots that preserve Git merge safety

Three corrections prevented duplicate or inflated issues. Actor activity is already implemented by actor list with last operation, claims, reservations and inbox counts. Unread already supports limit and returns the newest N; the remaining gap is safe paging and mark-read through. Inbox currently works with an explicit actor and has regression coverage, so the empty-inbox observation is treated as an identity-source hypothesis and invariant requirement, not asserted as a reducer bug.

Measured load is 2,157 loose ops and 8.6 MB, while board replay remains about 0.05 seconds here. The packing item is therefore a Git hygiene and concurrency RFC, not a performance emergency. Upstream import accepted 50 create/tag operations and 8 parent relations with zero rejections; fsck is clean at 326 ops. No Mote source files were edited.
